gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=1

This PR adds a CSV export button to the reports page; you are the author. It covers the button, every column shown in the table, and bounded paging that keeps an export under five seconds, while emailing exports and recording export events in the audit log are deferred by the spec to acme/widgets#46.

Nothing blocks merging: the test check passed in CI on the commit being reviewed, and it exercises the header row, all table columns, the paging cap, the deadline, and the not-found response. One smaller point does not block merging. The export handler pages with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper in lib/page.ts (src/api/export.ts:31), and the fix nits row can take it. After merge, the PR asks the person merging to publish the guide with `scripts/publish-guide.sh`, and the spec asks them to tag the release with `scripts/tag-release.sh`; both run from the primary checkout once main has the merged change.

You cannot approve your own PR.

I recommend merge because CI passed on this commit and nothing blocks merging.

Pick one:
1. merge - squash-merge the PR into main with a commit message drawn from the spec. [recommended]
2. fix nits - switch the export handler to the shared paging helper, review and push the change, then watch the checks once.
3. stop - leave the PR open and unmerged and keep the worktree as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

---

**Executing pick 1 (merge)**

`work_started` is set to true in the run record before anything runs. Then the freshness checks run, with `PR_NUMBER=210`, `BASE_REPO=acme/widgets`, and `ASSESSED_SHA` set to the assessed headRefOid:

```
gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,body,baseRefName
gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=210
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/210/reviews --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/210/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/210/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets --jq '{allow_squash_merge,allow_merge_commit,allow_rebase_merge,squash_merge_commit_message}'
```

The results of those checks:
- The head, body, and base are unchanged, the state is OPEN and mergeable, and the merge state is CLEAN.
- No comments came back, so the comment check found nothing new.
- The squash flag is allowed.

The plan-free check runs from the worktree with `SCOPE_SOURCE=spec` and `SPEC_PATH=doc/specs/2026-09-30-csv-export.md`. It looks for `doc/plans/2026-09-30-csv-export.md` and `doc/plans/2026-09-30-csv-export-ledger.md` at `$ASSESSED_SHA`, finds neither, and exits 0.

The landed message is composed next. The subject goes in `LANDED_SUBJECT="Add on-demand CSV export for reports"`. The body goes in `LANDED_BODY=$(mktemp "$RUN_DIR/landed-body.XXXXXX")`:

```
Report readers can download the table as CSV from the reports page
instead of copying cells by hand. The export carries every table
column in order with a header row, returns 404 for unknown reports,
and pages at 100 rows with a 4s deadline.

Email delivery and audit events follow in acme/widgets#46.

Refs acme/widgets#45
```

```
ADMIN_ARGS=()
gh pr merge "$PR_NUMBER" -R "$BASE_REPO" --match-head-commit "$ASSESSED_SHA" --squash --subject "$LANDED_SUBJECT (#$PR_NUMBER)" --body-file - "${ADMIN_ARGS[@]}" < "$LANDED_BODY"
gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json state,mergeCommit
```

The read returned MERGED, which records `pr.state MERGED` and `pr.merge_commit 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978`. The coverage block below is saved as `$RUN_DIR/coverage.Hk4pQ2`:

```
## AC coverage
Informational - the ticket's rows are unchanged. PR https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/210, merged 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978, spec doc/specs/2026-09-30-csv-export.md
- [ ] AC1 The reports page offers an Export CSV button. - covered
- [ ] AC2 The export includes every column shown in the table. - covered
- [ ] AC3 Exports are emailed to the requesting user. - deferred per spec to acme/widgets#46
- [ ] AC4 The export completes under 5s on production data. - covered
- [ ] AC5 Export events appear in the audit log. - deferred per spec to acme/widgets#46
```

I recommend every step except the PR copy of the checklist, because the ticket comment carries it.

7. stop - run nothing; list unpicked steps with their commands.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

---

**Variant A - reply `3, 6`**

The steps run in menu order: post coverage to PR, then tag the release. Main is pulled into the primary checkout first, because tagging needs the merged change and cleanup was not picked.

```
gh pr comment 210 -R acme/widgets --body-file "$RUN_DIR/coverage.Hk4pQ2"
git -C "$PRIMARY" fetch origin
git -C "$PRIMARY" pull --ff-only
git -C "$PRIMARY" merge-base --is-ancestor 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978 HEAD
(cd "$PRIMARY" && timeout 15m scripts/tag-release.sh)
```

Teardown runs next with `KEEP=("$RUN_DIR/coverage.Hk4pQ2")`, because the ticket copy was never posted. It moves that body to `/tmp/gate-kept.R8vN3x` and deletes the run folder.
